document: Q2 2026 Global Private Market Fundraising Report

pages.2: contents; table 'YoY changes in trailing 12-month fundraising activity by strategy'; 'Published on September 3, 2026'
pages.3: overview: private capital AUM $6.1T to $16.7T; H1 2026 $658.1B across 1,499 funds; 'If this pace holds through year-end'
pages.5: private capital cash flows; private debt 24.1% distribution rate, $39.5B 2025 net cash flow, TTM +14% YoY, H1 2026 +27.3% YoY
pages.17: Private debt: chart 'Private debt fundraising activity' 2016-2026 (capital and count labels); text on 88 funds, $158.3B, top five Q2 closes $54.4B (34.4%), Barings $19B
pages.18: Private debt AUM ($B) chart (unlabeled, as of December 31, 2025); dry powder $547B at end-2025, 'more than $120 billion' lower YoY; share of capital raised by type (unlabeled)
pages.21: Secondaries: private debt secondaries $16.1B in 2025, $13B through Q2 2026 across five funds (45.3% of H1); private debt 'almost $2 trillion in AUM'

notes: Hand-keyed from the PDF pages named on each point. Shape: series.<key> = { label, unit, cadence, geography, population, edition, points: [{ p, g, start?, v, doc, page, quote, locator?, note?, approx?, estimate?, provisional? }], caveats, restatement?, feeds?, catalogKey? }. p is the period end (ISO), g the grain (year, half, quarter, ytd, ttm, asof, window, rolling6m), doc a key of documents. Keys are the series-catalog group 2 keys; a catalog row that mixed units or populations is split into one key per measure, the catalog key keeping the primary measure and every sibling carrying catalogKey (see splits). A key may recur across the report files; points are unioned by key, and the same key, date and grain in two files is a restatement in which the later document's asOf wins. Threshold wording ('exceeds', 'almost', 'more than') is flagged approx; report estimates are flagged estimate; latest-period prints are flagged provisional.

pb_pd_fundraising_capital_q2_2026ed.caveats: Latest edition; supersedes the 2024 annual report for 2016-2024. The 2026 point is a half-year figure and is never annualized without 'if this pace holds' (p.3 wording; p.17 says 'At the current pace, fundraising for 2026 is on track to be the second-best year on record'). The run of years at or above $200B is computed from this series, never typed (seven on this cut, 2019-2025).
pb_pd_fundraising_capital_q2_2026ed.restatement: Every later edition restates overlapping years upward as late-reporting funds arrive (about 20% per the 2024 report p.5)
